verdict: EXISTING_SOURCE_CONTRACT_INSUFFICIENT; conditional additive release candidate only

existing_source.documented: VCO3.6GHz /3 stream /4 serial; related edges on one VCO grid. No specified divider phase relative to reset/refclk; pd model clears lock only. Behavioral oscillators free-run and do not implement divider reset.
existing_source.reset_bench: Stream66 serial74 HBM82 refclk edges after lock (two synchronization edges plus sequencer hold); GAP8 is deliberate existing behavior.

proof.frequency_alone: Stream rising=3n and serial rising=p+4m have common ticks dependent on p. All p=0..3 satisfy related/grid contract; no unique phase0 is bound.
proof.even_best_phase: Exact rational bench generously sets both rising phases0. Stream and serial raw release separated by8refclk=80ns at10nsrefclk. Actual x43 reset chain adds4stream periods versus3serial periods, equal3.333ns. It cannot remove80ns reset skew; 12 cold/warm phase residues all fail.
proof.warm: POR or lock loss restarts independent refclk release sequence. Waiting longer, common reset OR, or independent local2FF alone gives no common epoch guarantee. Repeated startup must re-arm both halves and choose a future jointly agreed epoch.
proof.not_claimed: No claim that all possible clock-observation/calibration circuits are impossible; such a circuit needs phase-margin/metastability qualification absent here.

sequence: Existing reset controller runs unchanged; either raw reset low asynchronously holds both capture halves low.
Each domain synchronizes both-reset-high into a two-FF armed acknowledgment.

Source synchronizes BOTH acknowledgments into its qualified epoch domain, waits declared margin, then emits the paired precommit for ONE future common rising edge. No data issue/ready/credits depend on acknowledgments.

Precommit signals satisfy setup/hold at the last local falling edges preceding that same common rise. Local release flops deassert resets on those falling edges. Existing leaf reset chains remain intact.
Raw first active clocks share epoch0; x43 first index0 is fifth stream/fourth serial edge, both epoch0+3.333ns.
Any raw reset/lock loss cancels source grant and arms; repeat this protocol before static production scheduling starts.
candidate_interface.source_implementation_required: PLL IP paired precommit outputs OR measured deterministic divider-reset/refclk phase contract plus implemented source sequencer. Existing source has neither committed implementation nor physical pins. Do not use ideal behavioral epoch as hardware.

cost.startup_commit_wait_ns: Source acknowledgment synchronization + up to3.333ns to chosen epoch plus required timing guard; unknown until source implementation.
cost.source_epoch_logic_area_and_clock_load: UNMEASURED; IP internal VCO access not assumed.
cost.timing: New falling-edge reset outputs require recovery/removal, min-pulse, CDC and literal die-wire/phi-R checks at TT/FF (SS sensitivity). No closure claim.

missing_measurements: Source divider reset phase for cold POR and every lock-loss/relock phase; exact rising/falling edge relationship to refclk and all output phase classes.
Source precommit generation mapped to actual IP pins and source synchronizer MTBF/guard specification, or qualified deterministic profile-bound sequencer.
Paired precommit routed setup/hold at coordinator negedge inputs; reset arrival/recovery/removal at all literal x43 rst/rsv pins, including independent ckvb entry.
Actual die native phase-R clock arrival and stream/serial pair checks for the capture bank seams; warm reset chain index0 alignment.
Mapped area, source clock-entry load, literal signal wire lengths and route/STA with an approved additive slot.

physical_policy.integration: Full-die keeps legacy binding by default and emits unresolved startup requirement. Enabling this candidate requires actual source pins/implementation and S-DIE-approved additive placement/routing; do not alter or pretend existing closed clock tile pins.

validation.mutant: Early serial release ignores common precommit; actual mismatch stream48ns serial40ns; vvp exit1 expected.
validation.legacy_reset_bench: PASS exact66/74/82refclk sequence across cold POR, PORglitch, lockloss, chatter.
